trip.notFound: This trip does not exist, or it belongs to another account.

actions.icsNeedsDates: Add dates to the trip to export a calendar.

regenerate.title: Re-plan the whole trip?
regenerate.body: The AI plans every day again. Stops you locked stay on their day; everything else is replaced. You can undo the result.
regenerate.unsaved: Wait for your last changes to save first.

delete.title: Delete this trip?
delete.body: "{{title}}", its packing list and documents will be deleted for good.

generate.title: Planning your trip
generate.step1: 1. The AI suggests places for each day.
generate.step2: 2. Each one is looked up on OpenStreetMap; anything not found is left out.
generate.step3: 3. Stops are grouped by area and ordered to keep travel short.

error.limit: You have used today's AI requests.
error.busy: The AI or the map search is busy right now.

edit.conflict: This trip changed in another tab.

day.heading: Day {{number}}
day.empty: No stops yet. Add a place or drag one here.

map.unavailable: The map cannot be shown on this device. The itinerary below has every stop and address.
map.label: Map of the trip
map.linesNote: Lines connect stops in order; they are not walking routes.

dnd.instructions: To move a stop, press space or enter, use the arrow keys, then press space or enter again to drop it. Press escape to cancel.

addPlace.title: Add a place to day {{number}}
addPlace.label: Search for a place
addPlace.placeholder: A museum, café or park in {{city}}
addPlace.failed: Search is unavailable right now. Please try again.
addPlace.none: No places found. Try a different name.

ai.label: Ask the AI to change day {{number}}

errors.limit: You have used today's AI requests. They reset at midnight UTC.
errors.busy: The AI is busy right now. Please try again in a minute.
errors.failed: The AI could not change this day. Please try again.

diff.title: {{action}}: day {{number}}
diff.nothing: The AI did not suggest any change for this day.

grounding.title: {{kept}} of {{suggested}} AI suggestions were matched to real places.
grounding.dropped: Left out because they could not be found on OpenStreetMap: {{names}}.
grounding.trimmed: Left out so days fit your pace: {{names}}.
grounding.unchecked: Not checked in time because map search was slow, so left out: {{names}}. Re-plan later to try again.

share.title: Share this trip
share.body: Anyone with the link can see the map and the day-by-day plan. They cannot edit it, and they never see your notes, budget, packing list or documents.
share.private: Turning the link off makes it stop working at once.

shared.missingBody: The owner may have turned it off.

duplicate.title: Use as a template
duplicate.body: Copies the days, stops, packing list and documents to a new trip, with nothing checked off.
duplicate.name: Name of the new trip

print.hint: In the print dialog, choose "Save as PDF" as the destination.
print.mapAlt: Map of every stop on the trip
print.footer: Made with Tripwise. Places from OpenStreetMap; times, durations and costs are estimates. Check opening hours before you go.

budget.disclaimer: All amounts are estimates in {{currency}} for the whole group, not quotes or prices.
budget.overrideHint: Type your own number to replace an estimate; clear it to go back to the estimate.
budget.noLimit: Add a total budget in a new trip to compare against it.

status.near: {{percent}}% of your {{limit}} budget, close to the limit.
